scope: Attribution (performance Rulings 9.1-9.6): the eight exact daily money lines over a window (summing exactly to the absolute gain G, presented with largest-remainder apportionment, Ruling 2.4), the Carino-linked percentage lines (reconciling to the TWR), per-listing and per-component breakdowns (Ruling 9.6), the conversion result (8.5), FX on a dividend receivable (8.1), the Southbound trade result in the price line, an all-reporting-currency portfolio (metamorphic check 11.3 #4), an interior five-session price gap (TWR AVAILABLE, attribution INSUFFICIENT_DATA), stale inputs (LIMITED), and a suppressed split position (SOURCE_CONFLICT). The since-acquisition view (9.7) is asserted in part 3 and not repeated.
change_notes: 1.2-part4 (2026-10-01): performance/1.9, answering the CP3e build. (1) Finding P22-V1: 'price_date_used' is the session of the close that VALUES a holding (part 1 format), and a holding withheld at 5 missed sessions is valued by none, so the engine was right and 1.1-part4 was wrong; P22-V1 now asserts price_date_used null (absent) and the new lineage field last_print_date 2025-03-07 (Ruling 1.1b). (2) Breakdowns are decomposition objects (Ruling 9.6 (1.9)): their parts are now 'apportioned' to the line's apportioned display value in the 9.6 order (P6: 5.63, -5.75, 6.87 = 6.75; previously independent 5.63 + 6.88 - 5.75 = 6.76); P3 and P21 display values are unchanged; part order follows 9.6 (1.9) item 3. No money line, Cariño component, total, state or reason changed; 28 items; pin the content hash. convention_sets are now stated as MINIMUM versions (Ruling 11.6).

1.1-part4 (2026-10-01): convention_sets.performance is performance/1.7, which fixes the attribution line identifiers (Ruling 9.2 (1.7)). Every line entry now carries 'id' (attr.price, attr.fx, attr.price_fx_interaction, attr.income, attr.fees, attr.taxes, attr.financing, attr.conversion); 'line' (the registry position) and 'name' are kept; the line is matched by 'id', and 'line' must agree with it. NO EXPECTED VALUE, STATE, REASON OR DETAIL CHANGED; 28 items; pin the content hash.

1.0-part4 (2026-10-01): first issue, authored and ratified by quant-analyst. Every expected value is hand-derived (CP3_GOLDEN_PART4_DERIVATION.md) and re-checked by derivation/cp3_part4_calculator.py, which implements Ruling 9.1 day by day from the events, asserts I-4 on every calendar day, I-3 per window and I-2 against the TWRs already asserted in parts 1-3, and links with Carino in Decimal prec 50. It imports nothing from src/. No value comes from the engine.

convention_sets.note: MINIMUM versions under which this fixture was derived and ratified; a checker accepts the same family at this version or later (performance Ruling 11.6).

extends.rule: Everything in the 'format' of parts 1-3 applies. P1 is cp1_golden/1.1's P1; P3 and P6 are part 1's (P3 at ledger_version 7, i.e. without part 3's seq 8-13, all dated after the windows used here); P12 and P13 are part 2's; P14 is part 3's. P21 and P22 are new and fully defined here. The market-data version M is ONE release: part 1's market_data + the market_data_additions of parts 2 and 3 + the market_data_additions below. format.inherits: parts 1-3 'format': presented 'value' (money ROUND_HALF_UP to the minor unit; ratios to 1e-12), 'exact' as a reduced fraction or integer string, 'window' {request, base, end, days}, 'detail' null = NOT ASSERTED, 'tolerance', value null iff INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Numbers are JSON strings, never float.
format.lines: Attribution lines are identified by 'id', the fixed identifier of performance Ruling 9.2 (1.7): attr.price, attr.fx, attr.price_fx_interaction, attr.income, attr.fees, attr.taxes, attr.financing, attr.conversion. 'line' is the registry position 1-8 (it must agree with 'id'; it orders the list and breaks apportionment ties); 'name' is an informative label only. Lines are listed in order and every one of the 8 is present. attribution_breakdown's 'line' is the position and its 'line_id' the identifier.

kinds_added.attribution_money: Ruling 9.3 over the window, in the reporting currency. 'total' {value, exact} is G; 'lines' gives each line's exact window sum M_k and its 'apportioned' display value (Ruling 2.4 item 3: floors toward minus infinity, shortfall to the largest remainders, ties in line order); the apportioned values sum exactly to total.value. INSUFFICIENT_DATA: total and lines null.
kinds_added.attribution_return: Ruling 9.4 (Carino) over the window: 'twr' {value, exact} and, per line, the presented C_k. A line that is 0 on every day is asserted as value '0' with exact '0' (Carino scales each day, so it stays exactly 0); every other C_k has 'tolerance' 1e-10 (Ruling 11.2, transcendental outputs). The presented C_k need not sum to the presented TWR (Ruling 2.4 item 2: within (8+1)/2 x 1e-12). INSUFFICIENT_DATA: twr and lines null.
kinds_added.attribution_breakdown: Ruling 9.6 (with 1.9): one line split into parts that sum to it exactly, published as a decomposition object. 'group_by' is 'listing' (the line's contribution per listing, summed over accounts, trade results included) or 'component' (per position {component: 'position', listing_id}, cash balance {component: 'cash', currency} or receivable {component: 'receivable', event_id} of the DIVIDEND). Each part has 'exact' and 'apportioned': the Ruling 2.4 item 3 display value apportioned to the line's apportioned display value in the attribution_money of the same window, so the apportioned parts sum exactly to it. Parts are listed in the 9.6 (1.9) item 3 order (which breaks ties); a part exactly 0 is omitted; components without the grouping key form one part keyed 'none'.
kinds_added.holding_value (1.2-part4): As part 1, plus the lineage field 'last_print_date' (Ruling 1.1b): the session of the last admissible print at or before D, reported also when the value is withheld. 'price_date_used': null asserts that NO close valued the holding (the field is absent); an absent key means not asserted, as before.

format.detail_names: As parts 1-3. SOURCE_CONFLICT and STALE_DATA items leave detail null (CP2 lineage causes).
format.engine_metric_ids: As in parts 1-3: the loader maps kinds to the engine's metric ids; a rename is a mapping change, not a fixture change.

portfolios.name: P12 (Example W re-dated to the fixture's FX: W')

assertions.purpose: Example W's eight lines on the fixture's FX. Day 03-31 (beta 10,000): BUY trade result (100 x 390 - 38,000) x 5/39 = 5,000/39; fee -50/39; conversion -5,000 + 38,800 x 5/39 = -1,000/39. Day 04-01 (5/39 -> 16/125, SYNH 390 -> 400): price 100 x 10 x 5/39 = 5,000/39; FX on SYNH 39,000 x (-1/4,875) = -8 and on HKD cash 790 x (-1/4,875) = -158/975; interaction -8/39. Day 04-02: income 200 x 16/125 = 128/5, taxes -64/25. Sum = 6,104/25 = G (part 2). Carino over the three days reconciles to the TWR 2,776,451/112,562,500.

The FX day alone, (03-31, 04-01]: only price, FX and interaction are non-zero; with one day, C_k = m_k / beta exactly (5,000/393,950 = 100/7,879; -3,979/4,924,375; -4/196,975), and the TWR is r_D = 58,421/4,924,375. The two FX components (-8 on the holding, -158/975 on cash) are the 'FX effect' line; the interaction is shown, never folded (Ruling 9.1).

Since inception. Piecewise-constant data: only seven days have non-zero lines (03-03, 04-01, 04-02, 05-31, 06-02, 06-10, 06-16); every trade is at its close except X3 (200 x 36 HKD closing value against 7,000 paid: trade result 128/5), the split day is neutral (sigma = 4), the in-kind MSFT inflow and all deposits and internal transfers contribute 0. FX acts only on 04-01 (5/39 -> 16/125) on A2's 0700 (17,500 HKD) and HKD cash (2,500). Sum = G = 1,135,523/390 (part 1); the daily product equals part 1's segment TWR (I-2).

structural_assertions.statement: Every result is marked synthetic (market-data Ruling 4.8) and every manifest cites the ids in 'convention_sets'.

Identity I-4, exactly: for every AVAILABLE or LIMITED attribution_money in this file, the eight lines sum to g_D on every calendar day of the window, and the window lines sum to total.exact = G (the gain_absolute already asserted for that window in parts 1-3, or here for P21 and P22).

Identities I-2 and I-3 in every attribution call (Ruling 11.1 (1.2)): the product of the daily factors over every calendar day equals the segment TWR exactly (P12-A1 = part 2 P12-R1; P1-A1 = part 1 P1-R1; P6-A1 = part 1 P6-R1; P3-A2 = part 1 P3-R1; P14-A1 = 1/40; P21-A1 = 1,067/15,625), and the sum of g_D equals G.
Ruling 2.4 item 3: for every attribution_money, the apportioned line values sum exactly to total.value, and each is within one cent of its exact value.

Ruling 9.4: for every AVAILABLE or LIMITED attribution_return, the internal Decimal sum of the C_k differs from the exact TWR by at most 1e-40 (Ruling 11.2), and the presented C_k sum to the presented TWR within 4.5e-12.

Ruling 9.6 (with 1.9): every attribution_breakdown's exact parts sum exactly to the corresponding line of the attribution_money for the same window, and its apportioned parts sum exactly to that line's apportioned display value.

Metamorphic check 11.3 #4 (P14-A1): with every holding, cash balance and flow in R, lines 2, 3 and 8 are exactly 0 in money and in C_k. Metamorphic check 11.3 #6 (P22-A1): an interior valuation-only gap leaves the TWR AVAILABLE and makes the attribution INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Determinism: byte-identical attribution results across runs, processes and PYTHONHASHSEED values, and with events shuffled within a day (ledger_seq unchanged).
